_what: The type a cover's headline is set in when the cover job is given none. One record sets every version of one ad: one face, one weight, one size, one band. Read by image_production/covers.py; the words are set by image_production/words.py `set_headline`.
_why: A cover's words are set by the tool, inside the cover job, never painted by the picture model and never added after the tool delivers. Covers of one ad came back with a different type weight on each when the picture model painted the words.
_curator: The image tool's owner. A job passes its own `type` to follow the swipe's type; a key it leaves out comes from `default`.

_fields.face: an id in the type library (components/video-edit/looks/fonts/<id>/), or a font file on this machine (absolute, or below the workspace or the mounted Drive). A face that is not found is refused, never swapped
_fields.weight: the weight on a variable face (300 to 900); a static face keeps its file's weight
_fields.size_px: the largest size, in pixels on a 1080x1920 frame
_fields.min_size_px: the smallest size the job may step down to so every version's headline fits at ONE size; below it the job refuses the headline
_fields.line_height: line height as a multiple of the size
_fields.max_lines: the most lines a headline may wrap to
_fields.zone: the band the words sit in, percent of the frame: top, bottom, left, right. Inside the 4:5 safe zone (top 14.8, bottom 85.2, left 5, right 95). The picture is asked to keep every face out of it
_fields.valign: top | center | bottom, inside the band
_fields.stroke: {color, px}: an outline around the letters, or null
_fields.box: {fill, pad_px, radius_px}: a filled box behind each line (the caption-on-a-box look), or null

_bands: The bands tried, in order, when a job names no `zone`: the first one where no version's headline lands on that version's product. One band is chosen for the whole ad. Lower-middle first: a frame of a person talking has the face in the upper half. Then the top band.
_default_from: components/video-edit/machine/cover_styles.json `instagram`: bold platform type at 100 px (about 5% of the height); 60 px was measured too small to read. Placement on the measured covers: top 24%, middle 21%, lower-middle 18%.
